name: create_ai_clipping
description: Submit a source video and return a job id immediately. The job runs asynchronously and produces one or more short clips per the requested output_settings. Poll GET /v3/ai-clipping/{id} or subscribe to ai_clipping.success / ai_clipping.fail webhooks.

video.description: Source video. Either a URL or an asset_id from POST /v1/asset.
video.title: Video

title.description: Title for the job. Defaults to the source video's title if omitted.
title.title: Title

inputLanguage.description: ISO-639-1 source language code (e.g. 'en', 'es'). Omit for auto-detect.
inputLanguage.title: Inputlanguage

outputSettings.description: Configuration for the produced clips (duration mix, aspect ratio, captions, etc.).

callbackUrl.description: HTTPS URL to receive per-job webhook callbacks. Mirrors /v3/video-translations callback_url. Per-job callback_url deliveries are NOT HMAC-signed: authenticate them by verifying TLS and matching the echoed callback_id, and do not trust an unverified body. To receive a signed payload, register a webhook endpoint with a secret (the signature header is sent only to registered endpoints).
callbackUrl.title: Callbackurl

callbackId.description: Opaque client identifier echoed verbatim in webhook payloads. Mirrors /v3/video-translations callback_id.
callbackId.title: Callbackid

AssetId.description: Asset input via HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint.

asset_id.description: HeyGen asset ID from the asset upload endpoint
asset_id.title: Asset Id

AssetId.title: AssetId

AssetUrl.description: Asset input via publicly accessible HTTPS URL.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the asset
url.title: Url

AssetUrl.title: AssetUrl

HighlightOutputSettings.description:
Configuration for the clips the job will produce.

Public projection of the internal ``HighlightOutputSettings``
(heygen/temporal/workflow/model/instant_highlight.py:27),
minus internal-only fields (``caption_config`` — internal StyleConfig from
the frontend, not part of the public contract).

duration_types.description: One or more target clip durations to produce. Each produces a separate clip.
duration_types.title: Duration Types

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for all produced clips. Default 'portrait' (9:16, social-ready).

captions.description: Burn captions into the clips. Set false to disable.
captions.title: Captions

caption_style.description: Named caption style preset (e.g. 'classic', 'bold'). Omit for the default style.
caption_style.title: Caption Style

prompt.description: Optional editorial guidance for the highlight model. Max 500 characters.
prompt.title: Prompt

HighlightOutputSettings.title: HighlightOutputSettings

OutputAspectRatio.description: Output aspect ratio for produced clips.
OutputAspectRatio.title: OutputAspectRatio

OutputDuration.description: Target clip duration. ``long`` returns the model's choice >180s.
OutputDuration.title: OutputDuration
